text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer learns to identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects in one image. These technologies have many useful applications in daily life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to recognise roads, traffic lights, and pedestrians. They must detect objects quickly to drive safely. Computer vision is also used in security cameras, medical imaging, and smartphones. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more important in the future.
